## GET empire-newsletter-status

**URL:** `https://cangoappempire.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/empire-newsletter-status`

**Mac:** `export EMPIRE_NEWSLETTER_STATUS_URL='…'` → `empire-news`

**Hostinger-Doku:** `/empire-editorial-squad.html`

Optional: Set-Node durch **Google Sheets** ersetzen (Tab `Newsletter_Stats` in Schaltzentrale).
